description: Add or update a mailbox the agents may read AND send from. Required: email. Optional: name, from_name (what recipients see), imap_host/imap_port/imap_user/imap_password/imap_folder/use_ssl for reading, smtp_host/smtp_port/smtp_user/smtp_password/smtp_implicit_tls for sending, is_default_sender, smtp_allow_plaintext. Both sides are TESTED before the row is written and the result is reported per side — a mailbox that fails when it is set up is worth far more than one that fails at the first real send. Matching is by address: calling it again for the same address updates that mailbox instead of adding a second. Passing only the SMTP half adds sending to an existing read-only mailbox. This tool is for IMAP/SMTP with a password ONLY: Gmail and Outlook mailboxes are connected in the browser (Integrations -> Mailboxes -> Connect Gmail / Connect Outlook), because OAuth needs a consent screen that no tool call can stand in for. Do not try IMAP with the account password for those two - both providers switched basic auth off, so it cannot work.

imap_host.description: IMAP server host name for reading

is_default_sender.description: Nimmt Mails auf, deren Absenderadresse zu keinem Postfach passt. Hoechstens eines je Mandant.

skip_test.description: Ohne Verbindungstest speichern — nur wenn der Server gerade nicht erreichbar ist.

smtp_host.description: SMTP server host name for sending

smtp_implicit_tls.description: true = TLS ab Verbindungsaufbau (465), false = STARTTLS (587).

use_ssl.description: Use SSL/TLS for the IMAP connection

name: add_mailbox
